evidence: Conditional accounts. The industry is a numerically closed sizing of equipment, freight and power for the stated orders; the orders are scenarios of demand, and the financing follows stated rules. Sources, plant, markets and prices await qualification.
reading_rule: Each case stands alone: one scenario of demand on one population ramp with one set of recovery measures. A checkpoint gives one financing arrangement at one horizon. The periods use the financing in U credit and are undiscounted; costs paid to Earth are imported machinery and its replacement, launch and imported materials, and outside services; the period of the founding deployment gives none, because that deployment is one amount. Material drawn is cumulative from year zero. Traffic is for the year of each horizon: the mass launched from Earth, cargo and any propellant for the Earth leg together, the launches that carry it at the stated payload and the pads those launches need at the stated launches a pad a year, and the round trips of the ferries, the lunar landers and the tugs to the sources. Workforce gives the jobs of the same year, the share of the available workforce they fill, the jobs that make working parts of machinery and the share of those parts made in place for orders of that year. Resources give, cumulatively to each horizon, the feed mined at the sources, what its water, nitrogen and metal yield at the stated grades and recoveries, what the system uses of each, what it sells, and what lies idle; nothing is held back while the protection gates reserve no quantity. A scenario case adds its sales: for each line whether it is served and from which year or was dropped as costing more than it brings, its worth at the comparison rate, its receipts, cost, quantity and mean jobs by period against the same orders without the line, and its quantity, price, receipts and the share of its demand served in the year of each horizon. A line's cost counts the financing's allowance on capital and, where residents cannot staff all the working parts the industry is able to make, the parts its jobs would have made. Water against the pool gives the water contained in the feed mined to each horizon (the feed times its stated grade, before recovery) beside the water of the source survey's two pools, the wider near-Earth screen within which the programme's sources lie and the broader near-Earth population that transport reaching beyond that screen would open, at their 5th, 50th and 95th percentiles, with the year the draw passes each. A case on a solved ramp adds how its schedule was found: the residents at each horizon, the growth rate of each period with the lowest rate found unsustained and the condition that failed there, the year the planned population is reached, and the margins of the schedule as residents.py measured them while the surplus was kept for growth; its checkpoints and periods finance the same schedule under the ordinary rules.
units: Years of the programme, residents, kilograms, constant USD2041.
